goal: D/Fplus/Fminus T600 seed0 baseline on all 4719 inputs retained by the user-approved official-results filter (14157 runs)

cluster.partition: cpu-mid (AMD EPYC 9454, 2x48 cores, SMT2, 1.5 TB RAM per node)
cluster.per_shard_slurm: 1 task, 20 logical CPUs (10 whole cores), 200G memory, --no-requeue
cluster.cpu_tokens: first 8 CPUs of the sorted affinity = one hardware thread on each of 8 distinct physical cores
cluster.container: gs-srun image genesis 1_26, Python 3.10 standard library, prlimit, taskset
cluster.proof_storage: node-local NVMe under proof_dir; deleted after a valid outcome, as in the original runner

budget_note: max_physical_cpu_hours is a per-shard admission ceiling set above the shard's worst case (about 590 runs x (600 + 1800 + 1) s = 393 CPU-h); it never binds. Solver worst case for the cohort is 2359.5 CPU-h; the expected total is far lower because solved runs stop early.

binaries.cadical: build/upstream of the main research branch: CaDiCaL 3.0.1 at c60730422e758ef1cebe7aeddf2dda31c996bf04, unpatched, configure -static, g++ 13.4.0 -O3 -DNDEBUG
